introduction_markdown: This paper is arranged in two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. Section A: answer ALL 10 questions in the spaces provided; the mark allocation for each question is indicated. Section B: answer ALL four questions; all questions in Section B carry equal marks (15 marks each). You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Non-programmable calculators are allowed. Duration: two and a half hours.
enonce_intro_markdown:
Given the statements $p$ and $q$ as

$p$: He is tall

$q$: He is handsome

Write in ordinary English

questions.corrige_markdown:
The symbol $\sim$ means "not", so $\sim p$ is the negation of $p$.

**Answer: He is not tall.**

The symbol $\vee$ means "or".

**Answer: He is tall or he is handsome** (or both).

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) $p\wedge q$ *[4 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The symbol $\wedge$ means "and".

**Answer: He is tall and he is handsome.**
